entities.name: Query protein 567 aa
observations: Sequence length is 567 aa; estimated molecular mass is 61.1 kDa.
Predicted theoretical pI is 4.77 and charge at pH 7 is approximately -38.8, indicating an acidic protein.
Strong homology to reviewed archaeal bifunctional tRNA threonylcarbamoyladenosine biosynthesis proteins: 66.6–67.5% identity, approximately 99% coverage, E-values 1.2e-253 to 1.6e-261.
Pfam detects a TsaD domain at residues 32–318; an additional HypF_C_2 hit spans residues 238–305.
Likely catalyzes formation of t6A37 in tRNAs and may contain a Bud32-like regulatory kinase module; exact domain assignment of the full C-terminal region is inferred from homologs.
Likely binds one Fe2+ ion per subunit based on homolog annotations.
Likely cytoplasmic and associated with the archaeal KEOPS/EKC complex; homolog complexes contain Kae1, Bud32, Cgi121, and Pcc1 and can dimerize.

entities.name: t6A37 tRNA modification
observations: The protein is implicated in modification of adenosine 37 in tRNAs decoding codons beginning with adenine, producing N6-threonylcarbamoyladenosine (t6A37).

entities.name: Archaeal KEOPS complex
observations: Reviewed homologs are components of a KEOPS/EKC complex containing Kae1, Bud32, Cgi121, and Pcc1; the whole complex is reported to dimerize.
The Kae1/TsaD-like portion is assigned the direct t6A biosynthetic role, while the Bud32-like portion is proposed to regulate Kae1 activity by kinase function.
